instrumentation: Isolated projects, system Chrome headless and real Playwright pointer/wheel input. Canvas bounds/computed-style wrappers add equal microtiming overhead. Latency ends at the first requestAnimationFrame observation of the exact DOM camera or object pose; it excludes compositor presentation delay. Inputs are counted as matched, superseded by a later committed pose, or pending, and final input plus persisted/reloaded state are asserted. CDP durations cover gesture plus 150ms settling; persistence polling is excluded. Fixture assets are synthetic and fixture media. These figures describe the measured scenes and input cadence.
notes: Final comparison uses sequentially created fixed IDs and explicit perf-object-00 target (Image 0.svg at x70/y100,250x160), with fixture order/name/geometry asserted equal across all four rounds.
Per-round p95 values are retained. Means of those p95 values describe variation in the measured scenes and are not a pooled percentile.
Older baseline-r1/r2/r3 and candidate-r1/r2 files, and exploratory-summary.json, used a random first object and are excluded from this fixed-fixture comparison.

CDP timings cover each action and 150ms settling; they include browser event work, DOM/layout and observation overhead, and exclude later persistence polling. DOM response ends at RAF observation and excludes compositor presentation delay.

Matched plus superseded plus pending inputs are fully accounted. Every final input, persisted view/geometry, cancellation and refreshed state is asserted. Activity media must continue increasing its cumulative video frame count in every phase.
